title: FADER_X X Air OSC address mapping
problem: FADER_X hides X Air auxiliary and FX return targets and its shared X32 code emits X32-only OSC addresses for them; X Air mixers also have no matrix buses.
reproduce: Select X Air mode and inspect the addresses generated for Aux In, FX Return and Matrix targets.
acceptance: X Air emits /rtn/aux/mix/fader for its single auxiliary return, /rtn/1-4/mix/fader for FX returns, rejects matrix and out-of-range targets, accepts matching inbound updates, and preserves X32 mappings.
repair: Centralize mixer-aware address generation, expose the two valid X Air return targets, route their inbound updates and reject unsupported target/channel combinations.

verification.limitations: The test compiles and executes the production address generator and checks the firmware receive/UI wiring. It does not flash a Teensy or connect to a physical X Air mixer.
verification.ownerCheck: On XR12/XR16/XR18 hardware, select X Air mode. Verify Aux In / USB Playback on channel 1 in both directions, FX Returns 1-4 in both directions, and confirm Matrix is absent. Record mixer model, firmware version and observed motor/fader behavior.
